mk_dirs_if_missing: the preset only makes the dir; write errors propagate (#112) (#121)

* fix: mk_dirs_if_missing preset only makes the dir; the wrapper does the one write (#112)

The preset wrote via super(type(self), self).__setitem__ and swallowed every
error with 'finally: return v'. For a subclass of a decorated class that
recursed until RecursionError (absorbed by the finally), and every successful
set wrote twice. Now the preset resolves the innermost key and, only for an
absolute path whose directory is missing and that the innermost layer's
validate_key accepts (#107), makes the directory; the wrapper performs the
single write and its errors propagate.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix: make dirs for relative rootdirs too; gate on a file-system innermost layer (#112)

Adversarial review: requiring an absolute inner key stopped mk_dirs_if_missing
from making directories for a relative rootdir (Files('data'), Files('') with
relative keys, graze LocalGrazed('relg')), which master did. The gate is now
"the innermost layer is a FileSysCollection" (a dict or other non-path store
still never gets a directory); a relative path is made relative to the CWD,
where the write puts it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
